entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, you're speaking with Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help me. I ordered a jersey last week and it finally came, but... it's just not right. I'm so disappointed, I've been a loyal customer for years.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're not happy with your purchase. I can definitely look into this for you. Could I get your name and order number to start?
It's Sarah Miller, order number VF-8675309. I just... I really needed this for a holiday ride with my family and I saved up for it. Now I'm not sure what to do.

I understand the frustration, Sarah, especially when you're looking forward to something. Let me pull up that order. Okay, I see the Aero-Fit jersey here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the size. It's the wrong size for me. I always get a medium, but this one is so incredibly tight, I can barely breathe. I feel terrible about it, but I can't wear it.

Not a problem at all, getting the right fit is the most important thing. Let me check the policy for you. I see the jersey was delivered seven days ago, which is great. Our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days.
Oh, so... I can return it? I was worried I'd be stuck with it and out the money.

Absolutely. We can definitely process a return for a full refund. Or, since it sounds like you like the jersey itself but just need a different size, we could do an exchange for a large instead. Would you be interested in that?
An exchange would be amazing! Yes, a large would be perfect. Does that mean I can still get it soon?

Yes, I can set up the exchange right now. I'll email you a pre-paid return label for the jersey that's too tight. As soon as you drop that in the mail, we'll get the new size shipped out to you. I'm glad we could sort this out for you, Sarah.
Thank you so much, Charlie! You've been a huge help. You really saved my holiday ride.
It's my pleasure. You should see that email in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
